outcome: Clinical heterogeneity (adrenal insufficiency, electrolyte imbalances, hyperpigmentation, congenital heart defects, atypical genitalia, salt-wasting crises, virilization, polycystic kidney disease, gallbladder stones, ovarian cysts, increased growth velocity, accelerated bone age)
cohort: Three pediatric patients diagnosed with 3beta-HSD2D at the Pediatric Endocrinology Department of the University Children's Hospital in Krakow.
finding: The study highlights the clinical heterogeneity of 3beta-HSD2D and that variants in the HSD3B2 gene contribute to diverse phenotypes, complicating diagnosis and management.
